name: Fasteners, Joints, Springs & Power Screws
summary: Designing threaded fasteners, power and ball screws, welded, bonded and riveted joints, and springs of all common types.

Bolt and rivet groups under eccentric shear
Welded joints: weld symbols, stresses in fillet and butt welds, static and fatigue strength

Belleville, leaf, wave and gas springs
Fastener materials, grades, corrosion and locking methods
